hero_title: Match the model to the task. Every turn.
hero_sub: Tokenomics sits in front of Claude Code and opencode and routes each turn to the model that fits it — across DeepSeek, GLM, Gemini, Qwen, Anthropic and more. Tool calls pass through intact; you see which model ran and why. Savings are measured, not promised.
support_per_turn: Per turn, not per session — matched to the work in front of it.
support_neutral: Provider-neutral. Bring your own keys; cloud or self-host.
support_shown: Every route is shown: which model, and why.
